About Me

Professional
Summary

I am currently pursuing a Master of Business Analytics at UBC Sauder School of Business, building on a bachelor’s degree in Statistics and Mathematics and a master’s degree in Cybersecurity.

My experience includes reviewing housing subsidy information and supporting data quality checks at BC Housing, helping students understand algorithms as a teaching assistant, and collaborating on a digital signing workflow through an industry capstone project.

I am interested in how data helps us understand the way things work — from business operations and financial markets to the choices people make. I enjoy examining patterns, questioning assumptions and turning complex information into something clear and useful.
